headline: Marui Group reported exposure of about 17.33 million records through a marketing vendor. Chainflip paused operations while investigating a potential vault exploit; Onchain Lens reported $4.86 million in outflows that Chainflip has not confirmed.

incidents.what: Marui Group confirmed that unauthorized access at marketing vendor PLAID exposed Marui retail and Epos Card data.
incidents.scale: 8.83M Marui records and 8.5M Epos records; not a unique-person count

incidents.what: Chainflip paused deposits, withdrawals, swaps and quotes while investigating a potential vault exploit; it has not confirmed the reported outflow or its cause.
CNN and NBC News reported that the FBI is investigating an apparent intrusion into its national crime database; the bureau had not publicly confirmed it.
CISA confirmed that attackers are exploiting a vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver.
incidents.scale: Known exploited vulnerability; victim count not disclosed

incidents.what: Universeum told guests that an attack on booking supplier Visit Group International exposed contact information.
incidents.scale: About 280,000 contact records; no payment data reported exposed

incidents.what: Staples Canada said unauthorized access at its print website exposed contact information, order summaries and encrypted passwords.
incidents.scale: Count not disclosed; no financial data reported exposed

incidents.what: Gothia Towers disclosed a website intrusion that may have exposed customer contact information and some ticket-order details.
ZebPay told customers some contact, device and recent activity data was taken in the MoEngage incident, while the vendor’s earlier notice said customer data was not accessed.
incidents.scale: Number unreported; ZebPay says funds unaffected

incidents.what: Austria’s foreign ministry said intruders accessed its externally hosted website and viewed staff names and work contact details.
The agency confirmed a cyberattack on its separate property-management systems and said it had no indication that sensitive benefits-recipient data was affected.
Dtravel said it was checking affected Base staking positions against the chain before restoring them.
incidents.scale: 35,656,691 TRVL originally stolen; no dollar estimate

incidents.what: Rokkatei said personal information may have been exposed in addition to payment card details in the previously disclosed store intrusion.
incidents.scale: About 8,000 card records initially reported; personal-data count unknown
